requirements.text: Customers should be able to easily select a service, a barber, and a time slot online, at any time.
Each barber should have the ability to manage their own schedule and time off within the system.
Customers should receive appointment reminders a day before and an hour before their scheduled appointment, via text or email based on their preference.
The system should prevent double bookings and ensure that the schedules are organized and clear.
The system must be user-friendly and cost-effective, suitable for a small barbershop environment.
